sop_thesis: **Turning Point Brands (TPB)** operates in Consumer Discretionary (Tobacco) with an established market capitalization of $1.52B. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Brand Equity, Omnichannel Logistics Scale & Customer Loyalty. Long-term valuation metrics model an intrinsic DCF fair value of $71.17 (18.0% margin of safety). Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $59.1 (Tranche 1), $55.49 (Tranche 2), and $51.26 (Tranche 3).
